jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you are in daily contact with candidates and customers.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs

• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English

• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

As Executive Assistant to the Executive Committee, you will support senior executives with agenda management, travel coordination, meeting organisation and administrative follow-up. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive professional looking to gain exposure to senior leadership within a fast-paced international organisation.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

 

 

Description

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to three C-levels, allowing them to focus on strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing calendars and organizing meetings.
• Coordinating business travel arrangements.
• Preparing and formatting presentations, reports and other business documents.
• Supporting leadership meetings, events and training sessions.
• Anticipating executives' needs and ensuring smooth follow-up on key actions.
• Providing ad hoc administrative support on strategic initiatives.

 

• You are looking for a first experience or already have a few years of experience as Management Assistant or Executive Assistant.
• You are fluent in French and English, with a good understanding of Dutch.
• You are organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• You are comfortable working autonomously and taking initiative.
• You communicate professionally and confidently with senior stakeholders.
• You are flexible, service-oriented and eager to learn.

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

Profile We're Looking For

• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.

Join an international medical non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting equitable access to resilient healthcare systems worldwide, including in Belgium, with the mission of ensuring that no one suffers or dies from preventable and treatable diseases.

The organisation operates across multiple countries, advancing public health through sustainable healthcare initiatives. It provides expert, compassionate care to people affected by tuberculosis and neglected tropical skin diseases, such as leprosy and leishmaniasis, which are closely associated with poverty, while working in close collaboration with local health systems and communities.

Jobomschrijving

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

1. Individual Donor Retention Strategy

• Define and lead the long-term individual donor retention strategy,
• Own and continuously optimize the donor lifecycle (welcome, engagement, upgrade,loyalty, reactivation).
• Drive donor retention, lifetime value and sustainable individual giving revenue.
• Align retention priorities fundraising objectives

2. Donor Experience & Engagement

• Ensure a consistent, seamless and donor-centric experience across all touchpoints.
• Lead multi-channel donor stewardship and engagement initiatives.
•  Strengthen donor loyalty, advocacy and long-term commitment through personalized engagement.
•  Coordinate stakeholders involved in the donor journey to ensure consistency and impact.

3. Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Define, monitor and report on retention, engagement and lifetime value KPIs.
• Translate donor insights into strategic recommendations and improvement actions.
• Evaluate initiatives and optimize resource allocation based on impact.
• Foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.

4. Data-Driven Donor Journeys

• Advance the use of donor data to personalize journeys and improve decision-making
• Partner with ICT and CRM teams to ensure reliable data, segmentation and automation.
• Optimize donor journey processes through data, testing, and technology.
• Ensure donor engagement is supported by accurate, actionable and shared data.

5. Mission-led Donor Communications

• Strengthen the emotional connection between donors and Damien Foundation.
• Shape donor communications together with Brand & Acquisition to maximize engagement and loyalty.
• Ensure storytelling and engagement support long-term donor commitment and sustainable revenue growth.
• Contribute to a coherent donor experience aligned with the organization's positioning.

6. Data Governance & GDPR Compliance

• Ensure all donor engagement, retention, communication, and data management activities comply with GDPR requirements and internal data protection policies. 
• Safeguard donor privacy, consent management, data accuracy, and the secure use of personal data across all channels and systems

• You have a master's degree in marketing, Sales, Economics, Communications, or equivalent experience.
•  You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in donor engagement, individual giving, donor retention, CRM-driven marketing, or customer/donor lifecycle management, with a proven ability to design and optimize data-driven journeys that strengthen loyalty, lifetime value, and long-term support.
•  Experience in the non-profit or social impact sector is an asset.
•  You are fluent in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent written and spoken English.
•  Strong organizational skills, with a focus on efficient processes, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
•  Strong digital mindset, with the ability to support digital transformation and leverage digital tools to achieve strategic objectives.
•  Opportunity-driven, action-oriented, and results-focused, with strong attention to detail and a proven ability to deliver long-term results.
•  Strong leadership, project management and change management skills.
•  Proven people management experience, with the ability to lead and develop teams through organizational transformation while fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate donor data into actionable insights.
•  Experience with CRM systems, donor segmentation, and marketing automation.
•  Experience with ERP software is an asset .
•  Excellent writing skills and communication skills

jobs.occupation: Freelance Program Director - B2B E-commerce Transformation

jobs.description:

To support its continued growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Business Development Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building relationships, and closing deals.

This opportunity is ideal for a true sales hunter who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch while managing a mix of short and long sales cycles.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Prospecting

• Proactively identify and target new business opportunities across Belgium.
• Build and maintain a strong pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
• Generate meetings with prospective partners through phone, email, LinkedIn outreach, and face-to-face interactions.
• Develop creative approaches to access key decision-makers and create new business opportunities.
End-to-End Sales Management

• Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact to signed agreement.

Market Development

• Monitor market trends and identify emerging opportunities.
• Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking activities.
• Share market intelligence and competitive insights with the wider business.

• At least a first experience in Business Development, Sales, Account Management, Partnership Development, or a similar commercial role.
• Demonstrated success in prospecting and acquiring new clients or partners.
• Experience managing different types of sales cycles, from relatively short transactional opportunities to more complex consultative sales processes.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Highly resilient, results-oriented, and motivated by achieving targets.
• Comfortable operating autonomously while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude and strong sense of ownership.

jobs.occupation: E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist - Retail sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing European player in the health, wellness and retail sector, with a strong presence across Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain.

Founded in 2014, the Group has developed a successful omnichannel business model, combining an extensive network of physical stores with high-performing e-commerce platforms. With more than 200 points of sale and over 2,000 employees, the company is continuing its international growth, driven by innovation, operational excellence and a strong commitment to customer experience.

Joining this organisation means becoming part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial international group where digital transformation and customer-centricity are at the heart of the growth strategy.

Jobomschrijving

As E-commerce & Digital Experience Specialist , you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the company e-commerce platforms.

Working at the crossroads of e-commerce, digital performance, IT and customer experience, you will monitor platform performance, coordinate incidents, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to the implementation of new digital functionalities.

Your excellent command of Dutch will be particularly important in ensuring the quality and consistency of the Belgian Dutch-language webshop, from content and translations to the overall customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance and operational KPIs of the Benelux e-commerce platforms, ensuring a smooth and reliable online customer experience.
• Oversee payment and delivery processes and proactively identify potential issues impacting customer satisfaction or conversion.
• Coordinate incidents with internal stakeholders across E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and Project teams, as well as external partners.
• Investigate root causes, recommend corrective actions and drive continuous improvements across processes and tools.
• Take ownership of the quality of the Dutch-language Belgian webshop, reviewing content, translations and the end-to-end customer journey.
• Analyse digital performance, user behaviour and customer data to identify opportunities to improve conversion, usability and overall experience.
• Set up, monitor and analyse A/B tests and translate insights into concrete optimisation initiatives.
• Contribute to the delivery of new digital functionalities, from gathering business requirements and functional analysis through testing and release validation.
• Manage and prioritise the e-commerce backlog in close collaboration with Group Project and IT teams.
• Support the implementation of new marketing, personalisation and digital optimisation tools.
• Collaborate with Benelux and Group teams to share best practices and contribute to the broader international digital roadmap.

• Native or near-native Dutch speaker, with an excellent understanding of the Dutch language and strong attention to linguistic and content quality.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in E-Business, Digital Marketing, Business IT or a related field.
• At least 4 years of experience in e-commerce, digital operations, web operations or a comparable role.
• Strong understanding of e-commerce operations, digital performance and customer journey optimisation.
• Experience in an omnichannel, retail or international environment is highly valued.
• Good command of French and professional proficiency in English.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and insights into actionable improvements.
• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable working across business and technical teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
• Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Contentsquare, Heap, Kameleoon, JIRA or similar platforms is a strong advantage.
• Knowledge of e-commerce CMS platforms such as Hybris, as well as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Google Tag Manager, is a plus.
• Curious, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a genuine interest in digital innovation.
